description_excerpt: Job Description Summary Install, maintain, and repair internal factory equipment. Supervise employees who perform maintenance and tool making. Impacts departmental operations and responsible for planning/execution. The role has some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures. This role is roughly 70% Facility Management and 30% EHS management Job Description Roles and Responsibilities • Ensure that manufacturing premises are fully operational, maintained, and clean.
